# Copilot instructions

This file is a GitHub Copilot adapter. Canonical guidance lives in `.ai/`, with `AGENTS.md` as the universal entry point. Read `AGENTS.md` first.

| Task | Canonical file |
| --- | --- |
| Routing, precedence, key commands | `AGENTS.md` |
| Project layout, pipelines, configuration, tests | `.ai/analysis-structure.md` |
| R coding | `.ai/r-coding.md` |
| R functions and tests | `.ai/r-functions.md` |
| Git and commits | `.ai/git-workflow.md`, `.github/commit-instructions.md` |
| Debugging | `.ai/debugging.md` |
| Review | `.ai/review-checklist.md` |

Keep this file short; do not add substantive guidance here.
